name: XTUSD
oneLiner: XTUSD is XT.com/XSC's MakerDAO-style vault dollar, minted against overcollateralized XTDao crypto vaults with limited public on-chain tooling for Pharos.
collateral: Overcollateralized XTDao vault collateral on XSC; issuer materials describe XT as the initial collateral asset with protocol support for additional collateral over time, but public live collateral composition remains hard to verify without XSC tooling.
pegMechanism: XTDao CDP: users mint XTUSD against overcollateralized vaults; risky vaults are auctioned to keep collateral above outstanding debt. Secondary market and account liquidity run through XT.com, and Pharos does not model a fiat cash redemption window.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XT.COM describes XTUSD as an XTDao vault system in which users mint debt against overcollateralized assets and unsafe vaults are auctioned. Those borrower-vault and liquidation mechanics establish the cdp archetype even though the current live collateral and control graph remain opaque.

oracleRisk.summary: Live XTUSD is minted on XSC Vat 0xf9d4810f… against ilk XT-A (WXT GemJoin) with a non-zero Vat.spot, but no Spotter (or other pip) is a current Vat ward among the live system contracts and the issuer announcement never names a feed, OSM, or failover. A parallel Maker-style Median→OSM→Spotter stack on XSC is wired only to the legacy TAI Vat/dai (token 0x775c4bc7…, symbol TAI on xscscan), not to the XTUSD token 0x1a6131ea… / live Vat path, so the live collateral-price path remains opaque.

branchApplicability.rationale: On-chain reads show a single live ilk XT-A on the XTUSD Vat with debt and spot set, but the pip/Spotter that should update that spot is not among current Vat wards (only Jug and XT-A GemJoin are wards of the tested system set). Liquidation/failover modules for the live path are therefore also unpinned. A fully wired Median/OSM/Spotter graph exists for the legacy TAI DSS only and is not treated as the XTUSD branch inventory.

reserves.name: XT.com issuer-managed reserve assets
reserves.issuerOrObligor: XTDao vault collateral (initially the XT token) administered under XT.com/XSC

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: The first-party announcement describes XT as the initial XTDao collateral asset and says additional collateral may be supported later, but it is a 2022 launch announcement rather than a current reserve inventory. A 2026-07-20 re-review found no current collateral weights, custody evidence, or XSC-readable reserve state. The single issuer-managed envelope is retained with explicit v9 classification rather than invented constituent weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Pharos reserve row retained as an issuer-managed placeholder; the reviewed source establishes the historical XTDao design but not a current composition snapshot.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The sole issuer-managed reserve row has no current, independently verifiable collateral identity or weight.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The official source describes XTDao collateral mechanics but does not provide a current reserve composition or verifiable XSC state.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: XTUSD is described as an XTDao vault stablecoin on XSC under XT.com issuer operations, but no reviewed source names a custodian, account segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation terms, or current vault-level collateral.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: XTUSD primarily circulates on XSC, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: XTUSD is tracked from market and issuer metadata, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a public holder redemption route for backstop scoring.

mintAuthority.summary: XTUSD is minted by a live MakerDAO DSS-style CDP system on XSC: users draw Vat credit against Wrapped XT (ilk XT-A) and the DaiJoin adapter 0xa57cde0585010aa1bcfadb3bf6f3445349bb98ab, the sole ward on the token, mints on exit. The 1,000,000,000 XTUSD per-collateral debt ceiling matches the issuer announcement and is effectively frozen because the deployer was revoked from every ward set and the only Vat wards are non-governance system contracts. The token and all system contracts are non-proxy with no upgrade path.

controls.label: XTDao DaiJoin (sole XTUSD ward, live)
controls.capDescription: Mints XTUSD on user exit against Vat dai drawn on collateral; bounded by the Vat ilk XT-A line of 1e54 rad (1,000,000,000 XTUSD) and the global Line of about 1.456e54 rad. No reviewed function on a current Vat ward can raise these ceilings, so the cap is effectively frozen.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017 (datarpc1.xsc.pub): token.wards(0xa57cde05...) = 1 and this contract's dai() = the XTUSD token 0x1a6131eaf7edd96afa10fc75b0d79dd814d19ed0, vat() = 0xf9d4810f1b140d869d2f92ca8da1755ea55e786b, live() = 1. Every other tested address (deployer 0xE8864ba6..., owner EOA 0x2571CC82..., DSProxy 0x34ed2cdd..., manager 0x5611e8f2..., GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe..., Jug 0x8276a38e...) has token.wards = 0, and a simulated mint(address,uint256) from each reverts XTUSD/not-authorized. Token Transfer(0x0 -> user) events across the xscscan history coincide with DaiJoin-style CDP exits.

controls.label: XTDao Vat (CDP debt engine, live)
controls.capDescription: Holds the XT-A debt ceiling (line = 1e54 rad) and global Line (~1.456e54 rad). Only Vat wards can file new ceilings or rely new adapters; the current wards are the Jug and the XT-A GemJoin, neither of which exposes such a call, and the deployer was revoked, so parameter governance is effectively frozen.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017: live() = 1; wards(Jug 0x8276a38e...) = 1, wards(GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe...) = 1, wards(deployer 0xE8864ba6...) = 0 and 0 for the CDP manager, DaiJoin, DSProxy, and 0x2571CC82 EOA. ilks('XT-A') = Art 4,325,685.43, rate 1.1097 ray, spot 3.478 ray, line 1e54 rad, dust 1e43 rad; Line() ~= 1.456e54 rad. A replay of a 2022 user mint calldata reverts Vat/not-safe (position would breach collateralization), confirming the frob path is live.

controls.label: XTDao GemJoin XT-A (Wrapped XT collateral adapter)
controls.capDescription: Custodies WXT collateral for ilk XT-A and holds a Vat ward for collateral accounting (slip); it cannot mint XTUSD and exposes no ceiling-raising call.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017: vat() = the XTDao Vat, gem() = Wrapped XT 0x4b681a704664ce482c45ec16ac9ecc9b121fb037 (name 'Wrapped XT', symbol 'WXT'), ilk() = 'XT-A', live() = 1, and it is a Vat ward.

controls.label: XTDao Jug (stability-fee module, Vat ward)
controls.capDescription: Accumulates the XT-A stability fee into Vat-internal dai owed to the vow; as a Vat ward it can alter system accounting but cannot directly mint XTUSD or raise the debt ceiling.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017: 2,450-byte non-proxy contract whose vow() = 0x73c190d6be81bbe3cbe96bb83d8ab66f1c645160; bytecode exposes file/rely/wards but no ceiling-raising path to the Vat's line; it is a live Vat ward.

sources.label: XSC public RPC (datarpc1.xsc.pub, EIP-1967 slot reads, 2026-07-27)

review.evidence: 2026-07-27 re-review (supersedes the 2026-07-20 unresolved review): the previously missing block explorer exists at xscscan.pub with a public API (api.xscscan.pub), and the XTDao system is a MakerDAO DSS fork whose contracts are all readable via datarpc1.xsc.pub at block 47,838,017. The XTUSD token 0x1a6131eaf7edd96afa10fc75b0d79dd814d19ed0 (3,991-byte non-proxy, EIP-1967 impl slot zero) reverts mint(address,uint256) with XTUSD/not-authorized from every tested non-ward; token.wards() returns 1 only for the DaiJoin 0xa57cde0585010aa1bcfadb3bf6f3445349bb98ab (dai() = token, vat() = 0xf9d4810f1b140d869d2f92ca8da1755ea55e786b, live() = 1) and 0 for the deployer 0xE8864ba6b3A6e2f5104A0ECFFd90E2C9fd2cb4Dc and every other contract observed across the system's xscscan transaction history. The Vat (live) has exactly the Jug 0x8276a38e... and GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe... as wards among tested system contracts, with the deployer revoked; ilks('XT-A').line = 1e54 rad and Line() ~= 1.456e54 rad, matching the issuer's announced 1,000,000,000 XTUSD per-collateral supply design, and neither Vat ward exposes a call that could raise the ceilings. The token ward set is effectively frozen because its sole ward (DaiJoin) contains no path to call rely on the token. The CDP manager 0x5611e8f241a6fd545b642dff90c6ad8c68f89b99 and user DSProxies (e.g. 0x34ed2cdd..., owner-gated by ds-auth) are user entry points, not mint authorities. Confidence is capped at manual-review because DSS ward mappings cannot be enumerated by direct reads: every ward candidate visible in four years of system transactions was probed and the deployer revoke was verified, but a never-used ward granted at setup cannot be excluded by this method.
